text:
jordan: quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: storage-cleanup caused a paging spike at ~03:15 UTC. ~100 pages, mostly duplicates. need minimal ops actions with owners/dates.

maria: confirmed. root causes: aggressive job retries + low threshold + no upstream dedupe.

kevin: propose 3 quick items:
1) bump alert threshold 3->12 failures/10m. owner: kevin. due: 2025-02-01.
2) add ingestion dedupe (collapse identical fingerprint for 2m, include count). owner: maria. due: 2025-01-30.
3) auto-silence scheduled cron windows (+/-2m). owner: sara. due: 2025-01-29.

sara: I'll PR the silence rule for the cron. cron is `0 03 * * *` UTC, right?

maria: yes. i'll add the dedupe change and a dashboard panel for duplicate-rate.

ops-bot: Created ticket SINF-712 - "storage-cleanup paging noise" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-712

jordan: agreed on collapse+count rather than drop. scheduling 10m sync Tue 09:30 PST to review PRs. If any owner needs to swap or adjust dates, call it out here.

kevin: timeline OK.

sara: ok for me.
